b6560b9711d89b44f344ef2c57076ff9.overview: In 1923 Berlin, following the suicide of his brother, an American acrobat struggles to survive while facing unemployment, depression, alcoholism, and the social decay of Germany during the Weimar Republic.
b6560b9711d89b44f344ef2c57076ff9.tagline: The kind of terror that could never be... until now... until Bergman!

b66cf71720d4c2de1bad0fe17f56f722.overview: In 1940s Los Angeles, two former boxers-turned-cops must grapple with corruption, narcissism, stag films and family madness as they pursue the killer of an aspiring young actress.
b66cf71720d4c2de1bad0fe17f56f722.tagline: Inspired by the most notorious unsolved murder in California history.

b678e4509e75cda3fe99cb02439e4339.overview: A writer leaves his upper-class life and journeys with a woman claiming to be his sister, and her two friends.
b678e4509e75cda3fe99cb02439e4339.tagline: An erotically charged descent into madness.

b6a55daef0e1ad2336ad274aeb228d2b.overview: The owner of a seedy small-town Texas bar discovers that one of his employees is having an affair with his wife. A chaotic chain of misunderstandings, lies and mischief ensues after he devises a plot to have them murdered.
b6a55daef0e1ad2336ad274aeb228d2b.tagline: Passion led to Adultery. Adultery led to Murder. It all seemed so simple...

b6b9a4ae8fb98242169ecd38a4c4f27f.overview: Alejandro, a tough and ambitious Latino street orphan on the verge of adolescence, lives and works in an auto-body repair shop in a sprawling junkyard on the outskirts of Queens, New York. In this chaotic world of adults, young Alejandro struggles to make a better life for himself and his 16-year-old sister, Isamar.

b6e9eebb00cbb4a5ba4d4d9eedbbf6d3.overview: Jealousy flares after the headmistress of an elite boarding school for girls becomes obsessed with a new student.

b6f9209f84de48a448d3cd39826a9b19.overview: An ambitious New York socialite plans an extravagant dinner party as her businessman husband, Oliver, contends with financial woes, causing a lot of tension between the couple. Meanwhile, their high-society friends and associates, including the gruff Dan Packard and his sultry spouse, Kitty, contend with their own entanglements, leading to revelations at the much-anticipated dinner.
b6f9209f84de48a448d3cd39826a9b19.tagline: HERE IS THE SCREEN'S CLIMAX OF GLAMOR AND THRILL THAT RAN OVER A YEAR ON BROADWAY! THE STAGE SMASH NOW A SENSATIONAL FILM TRIUMPH!
